calls.video_title: Procter & Gamble is Accelerating Revenue Growth as its Costs are Rising
calls.price_at_call: $166 per share (stated); updated DCF fair value $163 per share (stated)
calls.thesis: BUY reiterated, high confidence (was BUY 29 Sep; no flip) — excellent investment at current prices for a 5-10 year hold, one of the best-managed companies he follows; fairly valued on his DCF and on forward P/E, well within his margin of safety.
calls.base_case: Revenue growth accelerated to 4%, all from price increases with volume +2.4 points despite six years of price rises — against a consumer trade-down trend; near-record operating margin over the trailing 12 months; ROIC stepped up to ~17%+ since reopening vs 10-12% in 2017-19; stock up 15.5% plus dividends in 2026.
calls.bull_case: Historic operating leverage: ~3% revenue growth has typically delivered 6%+ EPS growth when costs stay flat; analysts expect ~5% EPS growth over the next few years, with productivity / efficiency and selective price rises offsetting input costs.
calls.bear_case: Bottom line pressured by rising commodity, energy and freight costs, especially in North America — costs rising faster than usual on the Iran war, tariffs and geopolitical shipping costs, in a weak consumer-spending environment.
